producer_report.summary: Drain no longer rereads on config changes that don't bear on a reading (reading validity compares a projection of the parsed config, so max_concurrency is ignored; defaults.toml and other relevant changes still force a reread). A reread whose capability, class of work and deliverable paths match the old reading is accepted by drain (AcceptedBy::Flag) and run. A reread whose scope differs is left proposed with a "needs accepting ... scope differs" reason and is not a failure. Drain never retries a still-proposed job; a no-outcome run is run again. Doc comments on GoResult::Reread and D38 and the CHANGELOG are updated. Full cargo test --locked passes.

checks_run.command: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test drain -- config_change max_concurrency scope no_outcome

criteria_check.criterion: A test in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs changes only max_concurrency in athena.toml after items are proposed/read; the drain lands them with no reread and no 'needs accepting' or 'no outcome' line. Run: cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain.
criteria_check.evidence: a_change_to_max_concurrency_alone_does_not_invalidate_a_reading passes. It asserts landed==1, outcome passed, one reader call, no 'reading again' progress line, no 'needs accepting' or 'no outcome' in the drain text, and stop != RepeatedFailure.

criteria_check.criterion: A test changes a reading-relevant config value (e.g. a budget cap or capability definition), so drain rereads; when the new reading has the same capability and deliverables as the old, drain accepts it and runs the job to a landed outcome in the same drain. Run: cargo test.
criteria_check.evidence: a_relevant_config_change_rereads_and_drain_accepts_a_reading_of_the_same_scope passes. It changes the job USD cap, then asserts two reader calls, a 'reading again' line, landed==1, outcome passed, and accepted_reading==Some(2).

criteria_check.criterion: A test where the reread scope differs (different capability or deliverables) does not run silently: the drain leaves the item with a clear reason that the reading needs accepting, and does not stop with 'repeated failure'. Run: cargo test.
criteria_check.evidence: a_reread_whose_scope_changed_is_left_for_a_person_and_is_not_a_failure passes. It asserts landed==0, stop != RepeatedFailure, a single attempt with outcome 'needs accepting', a reason containing 'needs accepting' and 'scope differs', the job still queued, and its state still Proposed.

criteria_check.criterion: Drain never calls retry on a job that is still proposed: when a run ends with no outcome, the drain's next attempt is a run/accept of that job, not 'only a rejected or failed job can be tried again'. A regression test reproduces the 01:48 sequence (max_concurrency 1 to 2) and asserts the stop reason is not 'repeated failure'. Run: cargo test -p athena-cli.
criteria_check.evidence: a_run_with_no_outcome_is_run_again_and_never_retried passes. Its log is read a, run a, run a, land a, with no retry or reread, and the stop is not RepeatedFailure. The 01:48 max_concurrency regression test above also asserts the stop is not RepeatedFailure. The full cargo test --locked passes, which includes all of athena-cli.

open_issues: I did not rerun cargo clippy or cargo fmt --check in this pass; they were not rerun after the previous pass.
mistakes: My first report did not map the existing tests to the criteria in criteria_check.
learnings: Grep and Read are denied outside the working directory, so the persisted tool-output file can't be searched. Use cargo test --quiet to get short output.
